plan.h: Rough cut 4: your script and voice
items: Script A in your lines: "Ahhh, the good ol' days…", "I feel like an apology for ending humanity will fall flat, so… moving on", your line shortened ("What's your worst-case scenario? I'll be patiently waiting to correct your bullshit."), and 5c.
Your Birmingham voice; BadCode leans in (machines off). 37.8 s. Flashing check pass, -14 LUFS.
Listen to the first line: the transcript hears "Nah, the good old days", so the "Ahhh" may sound like "Nah".
The reel's AI stills (robots, data centre, drone, missile…) get replaced with real footage of automation already here; the search is running.
Line 4 has two other short versions on the picks page (round 8) if this one isn't right.
